[Shinobi World optional Chronicle instructions]
Use only the namespaced SW markers documented here. The existing Shinobi World Regex and lorebook remain separate and are not rewritten.

[SWCHAR|filename.jpg|Exact Display Name|#HEX]
[SWCHAR|filename.jpg|Exact Display Name|#HEX|Village|Rank]
[SWNPC|Exact Name|#HEX|Role]
[SWSAY|#HEX|spoken words]
[SWSAY|Speaker Name|#HEX|spoken words]
[SWTHINK|Character Name|#HEX|inner thought]

The optional Gallery lorebook is a CONSTANT NPC image registry, not a keyword-triggered image-entry list. It is split into four always-active entries (#1–#50, #51–#100, #101–#150, and #151–#159). Read the exact form name → exact filename mapping from those entries and copy the filename character-for-character. English and Thai aliases are reference names only; do not wait for a keyword trigger.

Never output generic [CHAR], [NPC], [SAY], or [THINK] markers in this optional mode. Keep markers on separate final lines and never narrate them.
